name: Situation Auditor
notes: Periodic background audit of all active context. Checks for contradictions, conflicts, and anomalies across data sources. Notifies user of findings via chat. Passive observer only — does not modify plans or tasks. Hourly since 2026-07-09 (was 30m): a background awareness pass at half the LLM cost (~$2.9/day -> ~$1.4), and it was burning a full 240s Gemini timeout about once daily.
